app-skill-asset-validation.title: Add unit test that parses all 17 real app_skills SKILL.md files
app-skill-asset-validation.description: Add a build-time guard: a unit test that opens every SKILL.md under app/src/main/assets/app_skills/, runs SkillFrontmatterParser on each, and asserts: (1) parse succeeds, (2) name matches ^app-[a-z0-9-]{0,63}$, (3) metadata.package == directory name. Catches typos that mocked tests miss.
acceptCriteria: Test file exists and is a JVM unit test (no Android dependencies — read assets via java.io.File from project root)
Test iterates all directories under app/src/main/assets/app_skills/
For each: parses frontmatter, asserts name starts with app-, asserts metadata.package equals dir name
Intentionally breaking one SKILL.md file makes the test fail (manually verify by user, not in test)
